en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing an ornate fountain with a tall sculpted column and a Roland statue holding a sword, standing in an octagonal basin in a cobblestone square. Behind it are multi‑story buildings with large shopfront windows and German signage, awnings over the sidewalks, and a streetlamp. Several pedestrians and a man walking a bicycle appear in the foreground. The lower margin bears printed captions indicating the location and fountain name.
